interface.title: cellxgene (CELL×GENE | Annotate) v1.3.0
interface.stage_of_work: exploratory analysis and cell-type annotation of an already processed single-cell RNA-seq dataset
interface.what_it_is_for: Explore single cells on a 2-D embedding, colour them by metadata or gene expression, select groups by category, histogram range or expression, compare two groups with on-demand differential expression, and save cell-type labels and gene sets back to CSV.

data.note: The server was already running on pbmc3k.h5ad: 2638 cells, louvain clusters with 8 cell types, the QC metrics n_genes, percent_mito and n_counts, and the embeddings draw_graph_fr, pca, tsne and umap. The gene list holds only some genes: searching LYZ gave 'No matching genes' (screens/015.webp), while CD79A, NKG7 and GNLY were present. On first load a dialog asked me to name the directory for user-generated data. I named it 'pbmc_annot', so the files are pbmc_annot-cell-labels-5HGKLLWP.csv and pbmc_annot-gene-sets-5HGKLLWP.csv.

features.name: Coloured embedding scatterplot
features.general: Show items as points on a 2-D map, colour them by any chosen field (a colour bar for continuous fields; category colours appear in the category list), and zoom or pan
features.specific: Show cells on the embedding canvas, colour by louvain, n_genes, a gene or a gene set (colour bar at top left for continuous values; category swatches in the expanded checklist), and zoom or pan with the magnifier tool
steps: press a colour droplet on a category, histogram, gene or gene set
read the continuous colour bar or the category swatches
switch to the zoom tool and wheel or drag to explore
serves_tasks: Colour items by a group label to see how the groups separate
Colour items by a continuous quality measure
Colour items by the level of one chosen measured feature
Move around and zoom into a region of the map

features.name: Layout chooser
features.general: Switch the 2-D map between the precomputed layouts of the same items
features.specific: Embedding Choice popover ('umap: 2638 out of 2638 cells') lists draw_graph_fr, pca, tsne and umap; picking one redraws the canvas and updates the readout
steps: open the layout chooser
pick a layout
read the updated layout and count readout
serves_tasks: Choose which 2-D layout of the cells to view

features.name: Linked category checklist with per-category summaries
features.general: A checklist of group labels with counts that filters linked views. Each row shows a mini histogram or composition bar for whatever field is currently colouring the map
features.specific: louvain/type checkbox lists: tick or untick categories (or the master box) to select cells. Counts and the 'N out of 2638 cells' readout update, and rows show mini histograms (continuous colouring) or stacked bars (another category colouring)
steps: expand the category to list labels with counts
untick the master checkbox to clear all
tick the labels to keep
colour by another field to see per-label mini histograms or composition bars
serves_tasks: Keep or drop whole groups by their label
Check the new labels on the map and against existing groups

features.name: Brushable value histograms (linked range selection)
features.general: Drag a range on a histogram of any numeric field to select the items inside it, with other views updating to match, and clear the brush by clicking outside
features.specific: Brush the n_genes/percent_mito/n_counts, gene or gene-set mean-expression histograms. The embedding dims unselected cells and the cell count updates, e.g. 77 cells for n_genes > 1500 and 196 cells for high NK score. An active percentile clip changes these counts (49 and 194 on replay)
steps: drag across a value range on the histogram
watch the map and the counts update
use the selection downstream (cell set, label, subset)
click outside the brush to clear it
serves_tasks: Select items whose measured value falls in a range
Select items that score high on a feature list

features.name: Two-group comparison with differential expression to gene sets
features.general: Store the current selection as group 1 and group 2, run a statistical comparison, and receive the top distinguishing features for each side as reusable lists
features.specific: Press '1: N cells' and '2: N cells' to store cell sets, then press the differential-expression button. It creates 'Pop1 high' and 'Pop2 high' gene sets with gene rows and a mean-expression histogram, each colourable on the embedding. 'Subset to current selection' clears the stored sets
steps: select a population and store it as cell set 1
select another and store it as cell set 2
press differential expression
expand Pop1 high / Pop2 high to read the gene lists
colour the map by a result gene set
replace a set and rerun
serves_tasks: Store two groups for comparison
Compute the features that differ between the two groups and read the lists
Map a result list back onto the cells
Repeat the comparison with a group chosen by expression

features.name: Gene list panel with per-gene histogram
features.general: Search for features to add to a list. Each row has a sparkline histogram plus buttons to colour by it, expand its full histogram or delete it
features.specific: Quick Gene Search adds genes (genes absent from the dataset give 'No matching genes'). Rows offer delete, x, y, expand and colour
steps: type a gene symbol and pick it from the matches
press its colour droplet
press expand for the full histogram
serves_tasks: Colour items by the level of one chosen measured feature

features.name: Feature-vs-feature scatterplot
features.general: Send one feature to the x axis and another to the y axis to plot items against both, then hide, show or remove the plot
features.specific: Press 'x' on one gene row and 'y' on another to open the gene-vs-gene scatterplot, with 'hide' / 'show scatterplot' / 'remove' controls. Brushing cells inside it was not demonstrated
steps: press x on one gene
press y on another gene
read the scatterplot
hide, show or remove it
serves_tasks: Plot two measured features against each other

features.name: User-defined gene sets
features.general: Create a named list of features with an optional description by typing comma-separated names. Score each item by the list's mean and use that score to colour or select
features.specific: Gene Sets 'Create new' dialog (name, description, comma-separated genes) creates a set with a mean-expression histogram that can be coloured on the map and brushed. Sets are saved to the gene-sets CSV
steps: press Create new under Gene Sets
type a name and the genes
press Create gene set
expand the set and colour by it
brush its histogram to select cells
serves_tasks: Build a named list of features and score items by it
Select items that score high on a feature list

features.name: Selection-to-label annotation editor with autosave
features.general: Create a new labelling field, add named labels, and assign the currently selected items to a label. Each item holds one label, so assigning a new label takes items away from earlier ones. Labels show counts and colours, and changes autosave to a file
features.specific: 'Create new category' then '+' to add labels. Either 'Add label & assign N selected cells', or the label '…' menu → 'Re-label currently selected cells'. Labels are exclusive: assigning NK to 196 cells moved Bcell 342→338 and Mono 480→475. 'Show labels on the graph' writes label names on the map. The Unsaved → All saved indicator shows writes to the cell-labels CSV
steps: press Create new category and name it
press '+' and type a label
select cells by category or histogram brush
before assigning, colour by the label category to see whether selected cells already carry a label
press 'Add label & assign N selected cells', or use the label menu to re-label the selection
check counts and on-map labels, and watch the save indicator go to All saved
serves_tasks: Name the files where labels and lists will be saved (asked once, on first launch)
Create a new labelling field
Add a label, then assign the selected items to it
Add a label and assign the selected items in one step
Check the new labels on the map and against existing groups

features.name: Subset view to selection
features.general: Restrict every view to the current selection so ranges and counts recompute, then reset to the full data
features.specific: The 'Subset to current selection' and 'reset' pie buttons in the toolbar. The embedding readout changes, e.g. 1494 out of 1494, and the histograms rescale. Subsetting clears stored cell sets 1 and 2
steps: make a selection
press Subset to current selection
explore the reduced data
press reset to return to all cells
serves_tasks: Narrow the whole view to the current selection and restore it

features.name: Percentile clipping of continuous values
features.general: Set lower and upper percentile bounds so that colour scales and histograms ignore extreme values; the clip stays on and affects later range selections
features.specific: Clip popover in the toolbar (0 % – 100 % steppers, Clip button). Histograms rescale and their min/max labels turn blue to show clipping. The clip persists and lowers histogram-brush counts
steps: open the clip popover
adjust the lower and upper percentile steppers
press Clip
see the histograms and colour bars rescale
serves_tasks: Limit the colour scale so outliers do not dominate
